notes.title: About UPDATE
notes.notes:
Thanks for visiting JOY RESORT. 

We're starting the holiday break, but some people from our team are already working on the first update of CYBER SEX HORNY NURSES.
Thank you very much for your feedback, both positive and negative. We read them very carefully and will implement them in the upcoming updates.
We plan to add new content every month, we want to increase the number of attractions at JOY RESORT and add new simulations and new mechanics.
In the first update, we plan to add FANTASY SIMULATIONS where you will have fun with girls known from the fantasy world.

Thank you again

JOY RESORT TEAM

notes.title: 15.12.2021 Release date.
notes.notes: We are sorry but we are changing the release date but only by 6 days for the next Wednesday, December 15, 2021. We need these few days to localize the language translations for the game.

notes.title: Change of release date...
notes.notes:
We decided to change the release date of the game. This is due to the need to polish some things. The game is done all but we do not want to give you a game that is not polished. We'll need a month, maybe two, for this. We will announce a new release date soon ...
Please don't get mad at us for that ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: RELEASE DATE!!! July 24, 2021
notes.notes: We announce the official release date of CYBER SEX HORNY NURSES on July 24, 2021. We can't wait to show you our game. Get ready for some really hot sexual experiences.
